Parts.Description: A green meadow, a pebble yard before the hall and a cold blue fjord along the shore.
Parts.Name: Fjord Meadow

Parts.Description: The chieftain's hall: dark timber walls, a turf roof and dragon heads on the gables.
Parts.Name: Great Longhouse

Parts.Description: A stone forge with a tall chimney, a glowing hearth, a heavy anvil and a water barrel.
Parts.Name: Rune Forge

Parts.Description: A ring of stones around a roaring fire and a cauldron, with log stumps to sit on.
Parts.Name: Bonfire Circle

Parts.Description: A mighty longship with a dragon prow, a red striped sail and a row of round shields.
Parts.Name: Dragon Longship

Parts.Description: A long table with roast boar and mugs, two benches and a barrel of mead.
Parts.Name: Feast Table

Parts.Description: A wooden jetty reaching out into the fjord, with barrels, crates and a lantern post.
Parts.Name: Fjord Jetty

Parts.Description: A timber wall hung with round painted shields and crowned with spears.
Parts.Name: Shield Wall

Parts.Description: A little food store on stilts with a turf roof, so the mice cannot get in.
Parts.Name: Stilt Storehouse

Parts.Description: A tall timber tower on four legs with a roofed lookout and a ladder.
Parts.Name: Lookout Tower

Parts.Description: Two racks of silver fish drying in the wind and an upturned rowing boat.
Parts.Name: Fish Drying Racks

Parts.Description: Three round targets on posts and a line to throw from. Bonk, thunk, bullseye!
Parts.Name: Axe Throwing Range

Parts.Description: Seven tall standing stones carved with runes around a flat altar stone.
Parts.Name: Rune Stone Circle

Parts.Description: Four tall banners with the raven of the clan flapping before the longhouse.
Parts.Name: Raven Banners

Parts.Description: A log sauna hut with a turf roof, a stone chimney and clouds of steam.
Parts.Name: Turf Sauna

Parts.Description: A carved wooden throne with horns on a stone dais, guarded by two fire bowls.
Parts.Name: Chieftain Throne

Parts.Description: A carved totem pole of faces with a big black raven on top.
Parts.Name: Raven Totem

Parts.Description: A fenced paddock with a stable shed, hay bales and a sturdy shaggy pony.
Parts.Name: Horse Paddock

Parts.Description: A rocky cave full of gold coins, a treasure chest and shiny crowns.
Parts.Name: Dragon Hoard

Parts.Description: The showpiece: a giant horned helmet of steel and gold on a stone plinth.
Parts.Name: Giant Horned Helmet
